thread:
sara: FYI getting a huge spike of 429s for AcmeCorp org since ~07:20 UTC, looks quota-related :grimacing:
deploy-bot: [alert] 429 rate limit surge detected for org=acme-corp keys=2 count=412 @ 2026-03-17T07:21:12Z
kai: seeing same in gateway logs, 429s started immediately after the quota rollout job at 07:19Z, pinging infra
suresh: which rollout? the console snapshot job? I pulled the rollout history, release/quota-rollout-v3 applied at 07:18Z
joni: quick check: console shows per-key burst_limit for acme-corp at `0` (was `500`) — looks like a default got overwritten during conversion script :eyes:
sara: ugh, that explains immediate hard throttles. can someone confirm the console->runtime config sync path?
kai: runtime picks quota values from config-store via manifest-sync service. manifest-sync got a new transformer introduced in the rollout. suspect the transformer coerced missing values to 0 rather than preserving old burst values :thinking:
suresh: pulled raw manifest from s3: `orgs/acme-corp/quota.json` — snippet:
```
{"per_key": {"rate_limit": 50, "burst_limit": 0}}
```
that `0` is wrong, should be 500
ops-oncall: marking incident Sev2. mitigate first, then rollback. I'll take lead on mitigation
sara: mitigation options: 1) hotfix transformer to avoid zeroing, 2) patch manifests back to prior values, 3) interim temporary override on runtime to ignore burst==0. which fastest?
kai: fastest is a patch to manifest-store: restore burst to 500 for acme-corp and run manifest-sync for affected shards. can do a script to patch many orgs if needed.
joni: I can run a targeted patch: `aws s3 cp s3://manifests/orgs/acme-corp/quota.json - | jq '.per_key.burst_limit=500' | aws s3 cp - s3://manifests/orgs/acme-corp/quota.json` then force manifest-sync `POST /internal/manifest-sync?org=acme-corp`
sara: go for it, joni. I'll coordinate traffic reroute if needed.
deploy-bot: [deploy] manifest-sync job queued for org=acme-corp by joni at 2026-03-17T07:26:10Z
joni: patched and triggered sync, response 202. logs show sync picked up new manifest on shard-3
kai: observing gateway: 429 rate now falling from 98%->7% in last 2 mins. latency stable. good sign :thumbsup:
suresh: can we confirm no other orgs affected by the transformer? I grep'd manifests and found ~14 orgs with burst_limit==0 that were non-empty before
sara: start a quick scan job to list orgs with burst_limit<=0 and create a PR to batch-patch to default 500 for those that historically had positive values
ops-oncall: created incident task INC-2026-0043, assigned to suresh for audit and to kai for runtime guardrails
kai: adding short-term runtime guard: ignore manifest burst_limit if <=0 and log a WARN (will push change to canary in shard-3)
joni: canary patch deployed to shard-3 in 07:33Z, no regressions observed during 10m window
sara: action items: 1) revert transformer change in next rollout and add unit test, 2) audit manifests to restore burst for affected orgs, 3) add runtime defensive check to ignore zero/negative bursts, 4) postmortem and customer outreach to AcmeCorp.
ops-oncall: AcmeCorp SRE notified, they reported degraded UX but no data loss. Asking for ETA on full mitigation
suresh: ETA for full audit and patching ~3 hours, runtime guard deployed now, will follow up when batch patch done
sara: thanks all — keeping this thread for the postmortem notes. please paste any logs or commands you ran here so we have an audit trail.
kai: logs: `gateway: org=acme-corp key=xyz 429 burst=0 limit=50 at 07:22:05Z`
joni: command used: `aws s3 cp s3://manifests/orgs/acme-corp/quota.json - | jq '.per_key.burst_limit=500' | aws s3 cp - s3://manifests/orgs/acme-corp/quota.json` (will attach full output to INC-2026-0043)
sara: tagging this for follow-up on console UX around batch conversions — we need safer defaults when transforming legacy configs :warning:
deploy-bot: [note] rollout-v3 transformer reverted (partial) at 2026-03-17T08:05:12Z
ops-oncall: incident downgraded to Sev3 at 2026-03-17T08:16:20Z — service recovered but audit in progress :white_check_mark:
